# slsa-supply-chain-mcp
# SLSA (Supply chain Levels for Software Artifacts) v1.0 framework. Compute SLSA level + remediation roadmap for software releases.

## Install
```bash
pip install slsa-supply-chain-mcp
```

## Auth & Rate Limits
- Free tier: 10 calls/day. No API key required.
- Pro tier (£79/mo): unlimited + signed attestations.
- Enterprise (£1,499/mo): white-label + on-premise.

## Tools (5)

### `compute_slsa_level(query, api_key)`
Compute SLSA level (Build L1-L3, Source L1-L3) from CI/CD config

### `validate_provenance(query, api_key)`
Validate SLSA provenance attestation

### `remediation_to_l3(query, api_key)`
Roadmap to reach SLSA Build L3

### `list_requirements(query, api_key)`
SLSA requirements per level + track

### `verify_signed_artefact(query, api_key)`
Verify Sigstore-signed artefact + attestation chain

## Pairs with
- `meok-attestation-api` — HMAC signing for compliance certs
- `meok-attestation-verify` — public verification
